fields.why: The report computes its own yearly case counts (3, 4, 19, 45), a period contrast and percentages over a 38-patient, 45-case series, so 'yes' (A) fits; 'limited' (B) is defensible because it is a single-hospital case series. Lean A: it is more than a small series with context.

'The average length of admission was 11 days' is a duration of the illness's course, which the brief counts as continuous (A), but it is one descriptive figure the main claims (case counts, percentages) do not rest on (B).

brief_issues: data_focus: 'small case series' has no size threshold; a single-site series with its own yearly counts and percentages could go either way. outcome_types: unclear whether one descriptive duration (length of stay) is enough when claims rest elsewhere.
